subject: Interested in Redwood demo — GitHub integration questions
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@openlib.dev>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-01-10T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood demo — GitHub integration questions

Hi Camila,

I signed up for Redwood yesterday (great onboarding!) and poked around the hosted API. We're evaluating inference platforms to run code intelligence features for several of our OSS projects and enterprise customers. A few quick questions before a demo: 

- Do you have native GitHub integration (org-level webhooks / repo scanning) or is that something customers typically wire up themselves?
- Can Redwood access private repos via a service account? Any recommended auth patterns (apps vs tokens)?
- We care a lot about privacy and audit logs — do you support per-organization logging and retention controls when used with hosted?

Would love a 30-minute demo next week to walk through integration options and see a quick live run. I'm available: Tue 1/12 10–12 PT or Wed 1/13 14–16 PT.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Eng Manager, OpenLib
sam@openlib.dev
[OpenLib — open-source developer tooling]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@openlib.dev>
Date: 2027-01-10T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo — GitHub integration questions

Hi Sam — thanks for signing up and for the thoughtful questions. Happy to set up a 30-minute demo and walk through the GitHub integration options. Short answers up front:

- We offer both a managed GitHub App workflow (recommended) and token-based integrations for CI. The GitHub App supports org install and repo-scoped access.
- Private repo access is supported via the App/service account pattern; we can show the recommended permissions during the demo.
- Audit logs and per-org retention are part of our Redwood Private offering; for hosted customers we have configurable retention windows and export hooks (we'll share specifics).

Would either of these work for a 30-min slot:
- Tue 2027-01-12 at 10:30 PT
- Tue 2027-01-12 at 11:00 PT
- Wed 2027-01-13 at 14:30 PT

If one of those works I'll send a calendar invite and loop in our solutions engineer so we can answer any security questions. I attached a short sales deck that has a quick overview.

Cheers,

--
Camila Reyes
SDR, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
[Attachment: sales-deck.pdf (PDF, 2MB)]
https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/redwood-demo-30

From: Sam Patel <sam@openlib.dev>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T18:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo — GitHub integration questions

Hey Camila — thanks for the quick reply. 11:00 PT on Tue 1/12 works for me.

A couple notes so the demo can be productive:
- We'd like the SE to show how org-level installs look and what permissions are required.
- We host several private repos (some with monorepos) and use GitHub Actions for CI — would like to confirm support for that flow.
- We use Okta for SSO/SCIM at the org level; any pre-demo docs you can share on SSO would be helpful.

Please send an invite and I'll add the rest of the engineering team.

Sam
